annotations.title: Search ClinicalTrials.gov Biotech & Pharma Trial Sponsors

description: Find commercial biotech, pharma, and medtech companies running Phase 1–4 clinical trials via ClinicalTrials.gov v2 API with central study contact emails, phones, and company domains (`corridordata/clinicaltrials-biotech-sponsor-leads`).

conditionOrKeyword.description: Disease, therapeutic area, or drug modality (e.g. 'oncology', 'GLP-1', 'CAR-T').

industrySponsorsOnly.description: Restrict to commercial biotech/pharma/medtech sponsors (exclude universities/NIH).

maxItems.description: Maximum clinical trial sponsor leads to return.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Optional per-run USD spend cap forwarded to Apify Pay-Per-Event billing (`maxTotalChargeUsd`).

withContactEmailOnly.description: Only return trials listing a direct central contact email.

name: search_clinical_trial_sponsors
